scenes.narration: Your tea is cooling wrong, and here's why.

props.text: Most heat escapes through the top

scenes.narration: Most of the heat escapes straight through the top of your mug.
Steam steals that energy really, really fast, way faster than the mug does.
Want it hot longer? Use a lid, preheat the mug, and pick ceramic.

props.caption: A lid doubles your hot time

scenes.narration: Just adding a lid can double how long your tea stays hot.
A lid is honestly the cheapest upgrade in your kitchen.
Try it tomorrow morning and feel the difference.
